bugs.text: 'pressed' is declared const and reassigned with 'pressed={}' in update(): TypeError 'Assignment to constant variable' on the first tick kills the requestAnimationFrame loop; the game is frozen on the title screen and can never start (confirmed by result.json and all screenshots).
Stage clear can never trigger: dead enemies are filtered out at L551, so 'enemies.length&&every(dead)' is always false once all are dead; the stage never advances.
Challenging-stage enemies start in state 'path' with no segs, so e.segs[e.seg] throws a TypeError on the first challenge frame; 'waitPath' is never set.
Challenge waves never resolve once any enemy is shot, because dead enemies are never removed from the array.
'challenge' is never reset to null, so every stage after a challenging stage runs updateChallenge and normal enemies (state 'wait') never move: soft-lock.
After GAME OVER the 'hits' update case calls nextStage() instead of returning to the title; with 0 lives the player dies again into another game over, looping forever.
Title score table prints '100 POINTS' for all three enemies (uses r[1] instead of r[2]).
Boss scores pointsFor on its first non-lethal hit as well as on its kill.
Dual fighter can have 3 shots on screen; a dual volley counts as one shot fired.
Shooting an enemy during entry leaves entryLeft > 0 forever, so the formation never switches from sway to breathing.
Captive fighter position only tracked while its boss dives, so afterwards it is drawn at a stale position away from the boss.
Stage 1 badge drawn twice at the same spot; badges are plain rectangles.

summary: The code is a compact, reasonably organised Galaga attempt that on paper covers most of the arcade's features: Bezier entry waves into a 4/16/20 formation with sway and breathing, curved dives with re-entry, escorted Boss dives, an animated tractor beam with capture, rescue and a dual fighter, synthesized sounds and a correct fixed-timestep loop. But it never runs: 'pressed' is const and update() reassigns it, so the very first tick throws and the rAF loop dies, leaving a frozen title screen whose score table even shows 100 points for every enemy. Behind that crash are more game-breaking faults: a stage can never be cleared because dead enemies are filtered out before the clear check, the challenging stage crashes on undefined path segments and is never reset, and game over loops into the next stage instead of the title. Rendering also mutates game state in places. As delivered it is not playable and gives no Galaga experience at all.
